svg.title: One task, request by request
svg.desc: A sequence diagram of one task through the harness: the person, the orchestrator, the role agents, the harness hooks and git or GitHub. It shows each request, where a gate checks it and where a verdict is recorded, from the request to the merged pull request: the start gate with its dependency check, and the pull request write the harness journals first, with a person reconciling a write that had no observed result.
svg.text: Each request, where the harness checks it, and where it records a verdict
a request, intake or an import
grill.json: fingerprint of the spec and
agents' edits refused; the approved spec
policy: low-risk docs and refactor; else
start gate: spec, grill pass, approval,
re-runs the tests; judge.json with the
fail: debugger brief, then a fix
review.json per lens; a must-fix goes back
judge gate: current passes, tests, risk
what is proven, what isn't, labels
push; PR with receipt and labels
CI: verify with the base branch's
CI judge, if the project set it
only after a write with no observed
Checked or recorded by the harness
LOOP · UNTIL A PASS, THEN A PERSON
Sources: backbone/8-WORKFLOW.md and backbone/HOOKS.md at v0.32.0.
Both loops are bounded: the griller repeats until it passes, the judge until it passes or HARNESS_JUDGE_MAX_ROUNDS hands the task to a person.
